<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">

    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="28" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.VIBRATE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="32" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES" />

    <application
        android:name=".MyApplication"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.DragMe"
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules"
        android:fullBackupContent="@xml/backup_rules"
        android:icon="@drawable/drag_me_logo"
        android:label="@string/dragme"
        android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:largeHeap="true"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic="true">

        <activity
            android:name=".SplashActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
            android:theme="@style/Theme.DragMe.Splash">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/>
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/>
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <activity
            android:name=".main.MainContainerActivity"
            android:exported="true" />
        
        <activity
            android:name=".main.map.DestinationSearchActivity"
            android:label="Търсене на дестинация"
            android:exported="false" />
        
        <activity
            android:name=".main.map.RoutePreviewActivity"
            android:label="@string/route_preview_title"
            android:parentActivityName=".main.map.DestinationSearchActivity"
            android:exported="false" />

        <activity
            android:name=".WelcomeActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait" />


        <activity
            android:name=".FirstProfileActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait" />

        <activity
            android:name=".VehicleSelectionActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait" />

        <activity
            android:name=".BatteryOptimizationActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait" />

        <activity
            android:name=".OptimizationSetupActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
            android:theme="@style/Theme.MaterialComponents.DayNight.DarkActionBar" />


        <activity
            android:name=".main.MainActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden" />

        <activity
            android:name=".main.map.SaveSessionActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden" />

        <activity
            android:name=".main.map.ProcessingActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden" />

        <activity
            android:name=".main.map.MapActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
            />
        
        <activity
            android:name=".FullScreenImageActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden" />

        <activity
            android:name=".CountdownActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden"/>

        <activity
            android:name=".DragCalibrationActivity"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
            android:theme="@style/Theme.DragMe.Calibration"/>
        <activity
            android:name=".TrackSessionDetailActivity"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name=".TrackLapDetailActivity"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name=".TrackMapActivity"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name=".TrackSelectionActivity"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name=".TrackTypeSelectionActivity"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name=".CustomTrackBuilderActivity"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name=".TrackSessionActivity"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name=".TrackEditorActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:theme="@style/Theme.MaterialComponents.DayNight.DarkActionBar"/>
        <activity
            android:name=".ProfileDetailActivity"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait" />

        <activity
            android:name=".drag.DragRunPageActivity"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|keyboardHidden" />

        <activity
            android:name=".DragSessionDetailsActivity"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
           />
        <activity
            android:name=".drag.SessionSelectionActivity"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
            android:exported="false" />
        <activity
            android:name=".drag.CompareAttemptsActivity"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
            android:exported="false" />

        <service
            android:name=".ForegroundService"
            android:exported="true"
            android:foregroundServiceType="location"
            android:permission="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE"/>

        <provider
            android:name="androidx.core.content.FileProvider"
            android:authorities="${applicationId}.fileprovider"
            android:exported="false"
            android:grantUriPermissions="true">
            <meta-data
                android:name="android.support.FILE_PROVIDER_PATHS"
                android:resource="@xml/file_paths" />
        </provider>

    </application>
</manifest>
